title: PRM™ Designation (Professional Risk Manager)
source: PRMIA Professional Risk Manager Candidate Guide & Syllabus
summary: The rigorous quantitative financial risk management credential covering Finance Theory, Financial Instruments, Mathematical Foundations, Risk Measurement (Market, Credit, Operational), and PRMIA Standards across Exam I & Exam II.

standard.name: Standard PRM Track
standard.blurb: Pass PRM Exam I and Exam II (60% scaled pass score), document 2 to 4 years of quantitative risk experience, and uphold the PRMIA Standards of Best Practice.

stages.title: Stage 1: PRM Exam I – Finance Theory & Financial Instruments
stages.subtitle: Theory, Markets, Instruments, and Derivatives (60 MCQs | 4 Hours)

nodes.name: Exam I Curriculum: Theory, Instruments & Markets
nodes.description: Modern portfolio theory, CAPM, APT, equity markets, debt securities, futures and forwards, interest rate swaps, options pricing models (Black-Scholes, Binomial), and energy/commodity markets.
topics: Modern Portfolio Theory, Efficient Frontier & Capital Asset Pricing Model (CAPM)
Arbitrage Pricing Theory (APT) & Multifactor Return Models
Fixed Income Securities, Yield Curve Mathematics & Duration/Convexity
Futures, Swaps, Currency Markets & Credit Default Swaps (CDS)
Option Valuation Models: Black-Scholes-Merton & Numerical Binomial Trees

nodes.name: PRM Exam I Sitting
nodes.description: Computer-based testing evaluating theoretical finance foundations, financial markets, and valuation mathematics. Passing score: 60%.

stages.title: Stage 2: PRM Exam II – Mathematical Foundations & Risk Operations
stages.subtitle: Calculus, linear algebra, VaR models, and case study dissections (84 Questions | 4 Hours)

nodes.name: Exam II Curriculum: Math, Risk Modeling & Case Studies
nodes.description: Mathematical foundations (calculus, linear algebra, probability), Market Risk (VaR, Expected Shortfall), Credit Risk (CreditMetrics, Merton), Operational Risk (Basel SMA), and historical case studies (Barings, LTCM, Enron).
topics: Mathematical Foundations: Multivariate Calculus, Matrix Algebra & Probability Distributions
Market Risk Measurement: Parametric VaR, Historical Simulation, Monte Carlo & Stress Testing
Credit Risk Measurement: Probability of Default, Loss Given Default, Credit VaR & CVA
Operational Risk: Basel Capital Accords, Loss Distributions & Key Risk Indicators
PRMIA Governance, Standards of Best Practice & Real-World Case Study Dissections

nodes.name: PRM Exam II Sitting
nodes.description: Computer-based examination testing mathematical risk modeling, credit/market/operational methodologies, and case study analysis. Passing score: 60%.

stages.title: Stage 3: Experience & Designation Award
stages.subtitle: 2-4 Years Risk Experience + Continuous Risk Leader Commitment

nodes.name: Qualifying Professional Risk Experience
nodes.description: Document qualifying experience in financial risk management (2 years with Master's degree, 4 years with Bachelor's degree).

nodes.name: PRM™ Designation Conferred & CRL Commitment
nodes.description: Award of the Professional Risk Manager (PRM™) designation and annual participation in the Continuing Risk Leader (CRL) professional development program.
